correctness.rationale: The six vertex directions generate the triangular lattice with word length m(a,b)=max(|a|,|b|,|a+b|). Shortest paths reach every site in kH; splitting one nonzero step into two neighboring unit steps, insertion of cancelling pairs and 2/3-step zero loops give every k>=2 while excluding the missing origin for k=1. Independent integer enumeration agrees for k=2..6 and site counts 1+3k(k+1). Tessellating kH into unit equilateral triangles gives one common 3-corner distance distribution; the triangular-lattice Voronoi hex cell has area sqrt(3)/2 and radial disk/segment CDF, covering radius 1/sqrt(3), and mean squared distance 5/36. Initial six-kite integration yields initial CDF, covering radius 1 and squared error 1/4. Finite tests are corroborative, not proof for every k.
